description: Paste Facebook Page, Profile, post, reel, video or share links. Page and Profile links return their timeline posts; every other link returns that one post.

commentsSortOrder.description: Order in which allComments are collected. "Newest first" is the best choice for monitoring recent discussion.
commentsSortOrder.title: Comment order

contentTypes.description: Page and Profile links only: keep only these kinds of posts. Leave empty to keep everything. When matching posts are rare, the timeline scan stops after 20 × the post limit (at least 50) scanned posts and the run status says so.
contentTypes.title: Content types

fetchAllAlbumPhotos.description: The timeline shows at most five photos of an album post. Turn this on to list every photo of the album.
fetchAllAlbumPhotos.title: Fetch every album photo

fetchAllComments.description: Collect the full comment list of every post into allComments, up to the limit below. Adds a few requests per post.
fetchAllComments.title: Fetch all comments

fetchReelDetails.description: For reels, add the audio track (title, original audio or song, album art) and whether the reel can be remixed. Adds one request per reel.
fetchReelDetails.title: Reel audio and remix details

fetchSharedPostDetails.description: For posts that re-share another post, add the original post's text, type and counters to sharedPost. Adds one request per shared post.
fetchSharedPostDetails.title: Original text of shared posts

fetchVideoCaptions.description: For videos and reels that have captions, download Facebook's own caption file and add it as a transcript (SRT text plus plain text). These are Facebook's captions, not independent speech-to-text.
fetchVideoCaptions.title: Fetch video transcripts

includeCommentReactions.description: Add each comment's reactions split by type (Like, Love, Haha, …) with exact totals, also for busy comments Facebook shows as "1.2K". Adds one request per comment that has reactions.
includeCommentReactions.title: Reactions by type on comments

includeCommentReplies.description: Add each comment's reply thread (including replies to replies) as a replies list inside the comment.
includeCommentReplies.title: Include replies

includeTopComments.description: Attach the comments Facebook shows under each post (about 1-10 per post) at no extra cost.
includeTopComments.title: Include top comments

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Upper limit for allComments on each post. Replies count toward this limit when replies are included.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post

maxItems.description: How many posts to collect from each Page or Profile link, newest first. Posts removed by the filters below don't count. Single post links always return one post.
maxItems.title: Max posts per Page or Profile

minComments.description: Page and Profile links only: skip posts with fewer comments than this.
minComments.title: Minimum comments

minReactions.description: Page and Profile links only: skip posts with fewer reactions than this.
minReactions.title: Minimum reactions

onlyCommentsNewerThan.description: Keep only comments posted after this moment in allComments: a date (2026-01-01), ISO timestamp, or period such as "1 day" or "2 weeks". Comments are then read newest first.
onlyCommentsNewerThan.title: Only comments newer than

onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Page and Profile links only: keep posts published after this moment. Accepts a date (2026-01-01), a full ISO 8601 timestamp, or a relative period such as "7 days", "2 weeks", "3 months" or "1 year".
onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than

onlyPostsOlderThan.description: Page and Profile links only: keep posts published before this moment. Same formats as "Only posts newer than". Combine both for a date window.
onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Only posts older than

rehostMedia.description: Facebook's media links stop working after a few days. Copies are stored with this run and keep working; the original link stays in the matching …Original field.
enumTitles: Images (photos, thumbnails, link and author pictures)
rehostMedia.title: Keep permanent media copies

startUrls.description: Mix any public Facebook links. A Page or Profile link (facebook.com/nike, profile.php?id=…, /people/…/…) returns its timeline posts. A post, reel, video, photo, watch, share (facebook.com/share/…, fb.watch/…), permalink.php, story.php or public group post link returns that single post. Group feeds, events, Marketplace and search pages are not supported.

url.description: A Facebook Page, Profile, post, reel, video or share link.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Facebook links

title: Facebook Timeline Posts & Reel Transcript Extractor Input
